note: Set A is better because it correctly identifies the C5 South Floor Cantilever members (C8X11.5, HSS4X4X1/4, L3x3x1/4), whereas Set B misidentifies the C5 beam as W8X10 (it is W10X15) and misinterprets the drawing scale as reinforcement spacing. Both sets struggle with binding plates and dimensions to the correct detail view (confusing C1, C5, and A4), but Set B has more frequent misbindings and engineering interpretation errors.
remarks: Both extractions suffer from difficulty associating text labels with the correct graphical detail (C1 vs C5 vs A4) due to the layout. Set B's claim of 'reinforcement spacing' derived from a scale is a significant engineering hallucination.
